INSERT INTO platform_order_content_delete(id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, platform_order_id, sku_id, quantity, purchase_fee, shipping_fee, service_fee, vat, status, erp_status, product_available, picking_fee) VALUES

mapper.update: UPDATE platform_order_content poc JOIN platform_order po ON poc.platform_order_id = po.id JOIN shipping_invoice si ON po.shipping_invoice_number = si.invoice_number JOIN shop s ON po.shop_id = s.id JOIN client c ON s.owner_id = c.id SET poc.picking_fee = 0.0, poc.shipping_fee = NULL, poc.service_fee = NULL, poc.vat = NULL, poc.purchase_fee = 0.0, poc.purchase_quantity = 0, poc.erp_status = CASE WHEN poc.erp_status = '4' THEN '3' WHEN poc.erp_status = '2' AND si.create_by = 'system' THEN '1' ELSE poc.erp_status END WHERE po.shipping_invoice_number = #{invoiceNumber} AND c.id = #{clientId};

UPDATE platform_order_content SET picking_fee = 0.0, shipping_fee = NULL, service_fee = NULL, vat = NULL, purchase_fee = 0.0, poc.purchase_quantity = 0, erp_status = CASE erp_status WHEN '4' THEN '3' ELSE erp_status END WHERE platform_order_id IN (SELECT id FROM platform_order WHERE shipping_invoice_number IN
#{invoiceNumber} );
mapper.select: select sh.erp_code, po.platform_order_id, po.platform_order_number, po.postcode, po.recipient, po.city, c.name_zh, po.shipping_label_url, po.buyer_message, po.tracking_number, lc.zh_name as logistic_channel_name, lc.code as logistic_channel_code, poc.id as platform_order_content_id, poc.sku_id, poc.customization_data, poc.customization_url, poc.quantity, sc.product_name, ssr.remark, sc.price, sc.image_url, sc.sku, sc.is_necklace, sc.is_gem, sc.is_memo, sr.content_rec_regex, sr.content_ext_regex, sr.prefix, sr.is_size_regex, sr.is_month_regex, sr.is_comma_separated, sr.is_in_inches, sr.use_on_buyer_message from platform_order_content poc join platform_order po on poc.platform_order_id = po.id left join logistic_channel lc on po.logistic_channel_name = lc.zh_name join shop sh on po.shop_id = sh.id join sku s on poc.sku_id = s.id join shouman_sku_relation ssr on s.id = ssr.sku_id join shouman_category sc on ssr.shouman_category_id = sc.id join shouman_regex sr on sc.id = sr.shouman_category_id join country c on po.country = c.name_en where po.order_time > '2025-09-01' and poc.erp_status in (1) and sr.is_active = 1 and po.platform_order_id not in (select platform_order_id from shouman_order) order by sc.id, sr.priority;

select sh.erp_code, po.platform_order_id, po.platform_order_number, po.postcode, po.recipient, po.city, c.name_zh, po.shipping_label_url, po.buyer_message, po.tracking_number, lc.zh_name as logistic_channel_name, lc.code as logistic_channel_code, poc.id as platform_order_content_id, poc.sku_id, poc.customization_data, poc.customization_url, poc.quantity, sc.product_name, ssr.remark, sc.price, sc.image_url, sc.sku, sc.is_necklace, sc.is_gem, sc.is_memo, sr.content_rec_regex, sr.content_ext_regex, sr.prefix, sr.is_size_regex, sr.is_month_regex, sr.is_comma_separated, sr.is_in_inches, sr.use_on_buyer_message from platform_order_content poc join platform_order po on poc.platform_order_id = po.id left join logistic_channel lc on po.logistic_channel_name = lc.zh_name join shop sh on po.shop_id = sh.id join sku s on poc.sku_id = s.id join shouman_sku_relation ssr on s.id = ssr.sku_id join shouman_category sc on ssr.shouman_category_id = sc.id join shouman_regex sr on sc.id = sr.shouman_category_id join country c on po.country = c.name_en where po.order_time > '2025-09-01' and poc.erp_status in (1) and sr.is_active = 1 and po.platform_order_id = #{platformOrderId} order by sc.id, sr.priority;

SELECT sku_id AS ID,erp_code AS erpCode,(qty_not_allow_skip+CASE WHEN qty_allow_skip>virtual_stock THEN (qty_allow_skip-virtual_stock) ELSE 0 END) AS quantity -- qty to purchase for this invoice batch FROM( SELECT poc.sku_id AS sku_id,s.erp_code AS erp_code, -- shops NOT allow skip: buy all required qty SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(so.is_self_ignore_stock,0)=0 THEN COALESCE(poc.quantity,0) ELSE 0 END) AS qty_not_allow_skip, -- shops allow skip: buy only shortage vs virtual_stock SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(so.is_self_ignore_stock,0)=1 THEN COALESCE(poc.quantity,0) ELSE 0 END) AS qty_allow_skip, -- available+in_transit - reserved by uninshipped invoiced orders(未发货订单的占用库存量) -can not be negative GREATEST(COALESCE(s.available_amount,0)+COALESCE(s.purchasing_amount,0)-COALESCE(reserved.reserved_qty,0),0) AS virtual_stock FROM platform_order_content poc JOIN platform_order po ON po.id=poc.platform_order_id JOIN shop_options so ON so.shop_id=po.shop_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=poc.sku_id LEFT JOIN( -- do NOT subtract purchase_quantity; in_transit is already counted in purchasing_amount SELECT poc2.sku_id,SUM(COALESCE(poc2.quantity,0)) AS reserved_qty FROM platform_order_content poc2 JOIN platform_order po2 ON po2.id=poc2.platform_order_id JOIN( SELECT DISTINCT pocx.sku_id FROM platform_order_content pocx WHERE pocx.platform_order_id IN #{oid} AND pocx.erp_status<>'5' ) cur_skus ON cur_skus.sku_id=poc2.sku_id -- limit reserved scan to SKUs involved in this invoice batch WHERE po2.shipping_invoice_number IS NOT NULL -- already invoiced AND po2.erp_status IN('1','2') -- not shipped yet AND poc2.erp_status<>'5' AND po2.update_time >=DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 90 DAY) GROUP BY poc2.sku_id ) reserved ON reserved.sku_id=poc.sku_id WHERE poc.platform_order_id IN #{oid} AND poc.erp_status<>'5' AND po.shipping_invoice_number IS NULL GROUP BY poc.sku_id,s.erp_code,s.available_amount,s.purchasing_amount,reserved.reserved_qty ) sku_purchase_qty -- only skus with qty to purchase >0 WHERE (qty_not_allow_skip+CASE WHEN qty_allow_skip>virtual_stock THEN (qty_allow_skip-virtual_stock) ELSE 0 END)>0
